Some places you visit. Some places you become part of.

Revelstoke is a mountain in the making: North America’s longest lift-served vertical at 1,713 m, an average of 10.5 m of snow a year, and a real mountain town at its base. 

Winters are for deep powder. Summers are for bike trails, alpine adventure and long evenings downtown. 

Watch the series, then find your place on the mountain.

offer: Shop and sell ski and snowboard equipment at Ski Swap
title: Berkshire East Ski Patrol Ski Swap
body:
🎿 The Berkshire East Ski Patrol Ski Swap is back!

Join us on Sunday, November 15th, from 9 AM–2 PM to shop for skis, snowboards, winter gear, and more!

Have equipment you’d like to sell? Drop it off ahead of Sunday’s swap!

📦 Equipment Drop-Off:
• Friday, November 13: 3 PM–6 PM
• Saturday, November 14: 9 AM–5 PM
• No drop-offs on Sunday!
• No helmets will be accepted!

Seller Intake Form (please email to berkshire_ski@verizon.net): https://berkshireeast.com/images/2026_Berkshire_East_Ski_Swap_Form.pdf

Sellers keep 70% of the sale price, with 30% supporting the Berkshire East Ski Patrol. Maximum of 12 items per seller, with a $5 minimum price per item. Complete the seller intake form ahead of time or on-site during drop-off hours.

✅ Equipment Pick-Up & Payment:
Sellers must return Sunday, November 15, between 3 PM–5 PM to collect payment and any unsold equipment. Be sure to bring your invoice!

Massanutten Resort worth it for a family trip? 👀

We drove about 8 hours from Atlanta to @massresort in Virginia with our 3 kids, and there was definitely no shortage of things to do.

If you're looking for a family vacation in Virginia, a family weekend getaway, or a place where kids of different ages can find something they enjoy, here's what we experienced:

🌊 Indoor WaterPark like water slides, lazy river, wave pool + FlowRider surf simulator
🎮 Arcade
🔐 Escape room
🏎️ Go-karts
🌲 Outdoor activities + Family Adventure Park
🏔️ And of course, the mountain views

We weren't able to do everything. The weather was too hot for us to spend time at the Adventure Park, so that's one I'll have to save for another visit. Some of those outdoor activities are weather-dependent, so that's something to keep in mind when planning. 

So, is Massanutten good for families?

For us, yes. Having so many activities in one resort made it easier to find something everyone wanted to do—and with 3 kids, that's a big deal. 😂

If you're searching for things to do with kids in Virginia, planning a Virginia family vacation, or looking for a family-friendly resort for your next getaway, save this one.

📌 Massanutten Resort — McGaheysville, Virginia
Would you take your family here? Have you been? Let me know in the comments!

🏎️ Go-karts
🌲 Outdoor activities + Family Adventure Park
🏔️ And of course, the mountain views

We weren't able to do everything. The weather was too hot for us to spend time at the Adventure Park, so that's one I'll have to save for another visit. Some of those outdoor activities are weather-dependent, so that's something to keep in mind when planning. 

So, is Massanutten good for families?

For us, yes. Having so many activities in one resort made it easier to find something everyone wanted to do—and with 3 kids, that's a big deal. 😂

If you're searching for things to do with kids in Virginia, planning a Virginia family vacation, or looking for a family-friendly resort for your next getaway, save this one.

Would you take your family here? Have you been? Let me know in the comments!
